description:
Discover events with a linked filing dated within the last seven Beijing calendar days including today, and updated in the last seven days. A new filing may mention an old case; this does not imply new case progress. matched_filing gives the filing date and PDF that qualified the event; root source_pdf_url, phase and payload describe current event context. announce_ts remains the original first disclosure.

Call this to follow recent disclosures. Do NOT use it for unrestricted history. Poll from the top and deduplicate event ids. To page backwards pass both cursor and cursor_aevt verbatim; these use processing time, not filing dates. Old cursors restart at the current window with clamped=true. Concurrent updates can move results between pages. end_of_window=true means no further results, including an empty first call; empty results are successful and do not prove the database is empty or ingestion is healthy. fallback_recent is always false: history never fills an empty window. Use a known company, entity or event for historical context.

cursor.description: The `cursor` value from a previous response, passed back verbatim.
cursor.title: Cursor

cursor_aevt.description: The `cursor_aevt` value from the same response. Required together with cursor for correct paging.
cursor_aevt.title: Cursor Aevt

name: whats_new

outputSchema.description: Recently created or updated events, newest first.

clamped.description: Your cursor was older than the lookback window, so paging restarted from the top of the window.
clamped.title: Clamped

cursor.description: Pass back verbatim as `cursor` together with `cursor_aevt` to get the next page. Null means there is no next page. Do not construct it yourself.
cursor.title: Cursor

cursor_aevt.description: Second half of the cursor. Both halves are required to page correctly; passing only `cursor` may repeat events sharing the same timestamp.
cursor_aevt.title: Cursor Aevt

end_of_window.description: No more results in the allowed window for this request, including an empty first call. Events is empty and both cursor fields are null; this does not imply an empty database.
end_of_window.title: End Of Window

fallback_recent.description: Always false: an empty window never returns older events.
fallback_recent.title: Fallback Recent
